findings.mechanism: Lines missing from the output are parsed as 0, and expected lines whose value is 0 then count as correct, so an empty reply earns 42-47% on both per-line metrics (reward 0.42-0.47 of a maximum 7.0).

note: Full reward needs every line exactly right, which requires computing the return; no leakage of the expected XML into the prompt.
